The '''Niruu Plateau''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. It was home to the [[Niruu]] [[Alwari]] and [[sanwiwood]] grew there.<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>
